find: unless Congress invokes Rebellion or Invasion or provides an adequate judicial substitute
replace: unless an actual rebellion or invasion requires suspension for public safety, or Congress provides an adequate judicial substitute
reason: The Constitution requires both rebellion or invasion and a public-safety need. Invoking one of the conditions does not suffice.
